reason: The power cuts are a real trouble for me, but I only buy brands I see on TV like LG or Samsung, and here nobody tells me whose machine this is. ₹21,999 is nearly double a normal semi-automatic, and I will not put that much into a name I don't know just because the local dealer says so.
objection: If the battery dies after the third year or the dealer shuts shop, who will give me spare parts for an unknown machine? And will a cold wash even get the mud out of farm clothes? Otherwise I am scrubbing them by hand again anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If a big TV brand I trust made it, or stood behind the battery with its own service centre in our district, and a neighbour showed me it cleaning muddy clothes on battery.
